name: NFT and Online Gaming / In-Game Currency Laundering
description: Non-fungible tokens and in-game currencies can be bought, sold or transferred with subjective or opaque values, enabling wash trading, self-dealing and conversion of illicit funds into items that are later resold. Gaming platforms also host cross-border micro-transfers that hide value movement.

sources.text: US Department of the Treasury, Illicit Finance Risk Assessment of Non-Fungible Tokens (2024)
FATF, Updated Guidance for a Risk-Based Approach to Virtual Assets and Virtual Asset Service Providers (2021)
FATF, Money Laundering and Terrorist Financing in the Art and Antiquities Market (2023)

indicators.name: Wash trading between wallets controlled by the same party
indicators.canon: Wash or matched trades between connected parties
indicators.desc: Assets or securities are traded repeatedly between linked accounts or wallets at unrealistic prices.
indicators.ctx: NFTs are sold repeatedly between linked wallets at rising prices without genuine third-party demand.
indicators.fp: Collectors moving assets between own wallets.

indicators.name: Purchase price far above comparable floor or last sale
indicators.canon: Transaction price materially different from market value
indicators.desc: Price paid differs sharply from market value, comparable sales or estimates without commercial justification.
indicators.ctx: A buyer pays a large premium for an item without supporting valuation.

indicators.name: Newly minted NFT sold immediately for large sums to unrelated wallet
indicators.canon: Newly minted NFT sold immediately for large sums to unrelated wallet
indicators.desc: Creator mints and sells quickly to a single buyer funded by a cluster with no history.
indicators.ctx: Creator mints and sells quickly to a single buyer funded by a cluster with no history.

indicators.name: Fast conversion of in-game currency to cash or crypto
indicators.canon: Fast conversion of in-game currency to cash or crypto
indicators.desc: Large currency amounts earned or received are cashed out through third-party sites within a short period.
indicators.ctx: Large currency amounts earned or received are cashed out through third-party sites within a short period.

indicators.name: Many low-value in-game transfers from unrelated accounts to one account
indicators.canon: Many unrelated senders paying a single account or recipient
indicators.desc: Numerous unrelated payers send frequent, often small, payments to one account, wallet or beneficiary, or one funder pays many beneficiaries, with no clear commercial relationship.
indicators.ctx: Fan-in of small gifts or trades into a single collector, then withdrawal.

indicators.name: Accounts bought with stolen cards then items resold
indicators.canon: Accounts bought with stolen cards then items resold
indicators.desc: Chargebacks on purchases of currency or items followed by transfer to other accounts.
indicators.ctx: Chargebacks on purchases of currency or items followed by transfer to other accounts.

indicators.name: Marketplace sellers with no identity verification receiving large payouts
indicators.canon: Marketplace sellers with no identity verification receiving large payouts
indicators.desc: Pseudonymous sellers withdraw significant proceeds to fiat or exchange wallets.
indicators.ctx: Pseudonymous sellers withdraw significant proceeds to fiat or exchange wallets.

indicators.name: Use of mixers or privacy tools before purchasing NFTs
indicators.canon: Use of mixers, privacy coins or privacy pools around platform activity
indicators.desc: Funds pass through mixers, privacy coins or privacy-preserving pools before or after platform activity without commercial rationale.
indicators.ctx: Purchase funding traces through obfuscation services.

indicators.name: Sanctioned or high-risk jurisdiction counterparties in game economies
indicators.canon: Counterparty or flows in higher-risk jurisdictions with weak AML controls
indicators.desc: Funds, counterparties or institutions are located in jurisdictions with weak AML supervision, sanctions exposure or limited VASP regulation.
indicators.ctx: Transfers or sales involve users in sanctioned regions, detected via geolocation or wallet data.

indicators.name: Marketplace or game operator lacks AML controls
indicators.canon: Marketplace or game operator lacks AML controls
indicators.desc: Operator permits unlimited withdrawal and trade, ignores abuse reports and does not verify high-value users.
indicators.ctx: Operator permits unlimited withdrawal and trade, ignores abuse reports and does not verify high-value users.
